name: CountBench
intro: CountBench是一个用于评估视觉语言模型（VLM）对象计数能力的新型图像-文本计数基准。它通过自动创建反事实示例来改进VLM的定量理解，并鼓励模型区分正确和不正确的计数描述。该基准旨在评估模型对图像中对象数量的理解。
build_method: LAION-400M数字词过滤, 目标检测计数匹配, 数量平衡, 人工验证
eval_feature: 测试集与计数训练集无重叠, 九分类零样本图文相似度
eval_feature_en: No overlap with counting training set, nine-way zero-shot image-text similarity
intro_en: CountBench is a novel image-text counting benchmark designed to evaluate the object counting ability of vision-language models (VLMs). It improves VLMs' quantitative understanding by automatically generating counterfactual examples and encourages models to distinguish between correct and incorrect counting descriptions. This benchmark aims to assess models' comprehension of object quantities in images.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2302.12066 Section 4 and Section 5.1. CountBench is automatically curated and manually verified from public LAION-400M. The authors retain captions with spelled counts two through ten, reject uses such as age, time, dates, addresses, and other non-visible attributes, then use an off-the-shelf detector to count each object class and keep cases where the caption count matches the most prevalent detected class. Candidates are extremely imbalanced (over 158K for two versus about 100 for ten), so each number is pre-balanced to 100–200 candidates, manually verified against clearly visible objects, and rebalanced to 60 pairs per number. The final 540-image test set has no overlap with the counting training set. Evaluation replaces each caption count with all nine values from two through ten, computes image-text similarity for each, chooses the highest-scoring number, and reports Counting Accuracy and Mean Count Deviation.
